summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests Trans-Arterial Tirapazamine Embolization (TATE) given with pembrolizumab in people with liver metastases from colorectal cancer or non-small cell lung cancer. All liver metastatic lesions are treated with TATE, and pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion every 3 or 6 weeks until progression or for a maximum of 2 years. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la embolización transarterial con tirapazamina (TATE) combinada con pembrolizumab en personas con metástasis hepáticas de cáncer colorrectal o de cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. Todas las lesiones metastásicas del hígado se tratan con TATE, y el pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 o 6 semanas hasta la progresión o por un máximo de 2 años. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Liver metastatic MSS colorectal cancer or NSCLC without EGFR or AKT mutations
Colorectal cancer progressed on at least two chemotherapy lines, or NSCLC progressed on chemotherapy and an immune checkpoint inhibitor
At least 4 weeks from prior chemotherapy and free from chemotherapy-related toxicity
not_for: Liver metastases involving more than 50% of the liver
Oxygen saturation below 92% on room air
Prior autoimmune disorder or CNS metastasis
Major GI bleeding in the last 2 months
